input.body:
## Summary

```text
World.unlockedParts
  → GameShell → TankCreator
                   ├─ palette membership
                   ├─ save validation
                   └─ viewer load limits
```

After a level drop, earned parts now remain available when editing, saving and loading a design. Current GP/class/complexity limits still apply. Menu editing keeps its existing fallback.

Final component slice of original `ed573ba`, following #99 and #100. Earlier dialog, details and input corrections are preserved. All 16 original paths are accounted for; the checkpoint remains unlanded until its slices merge.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The regression fixture earns Radar, performs two real World downgrades to level 1, and reports retained Radar in World; the creator still disables it as “unlocks at level 3.” The new browser regression fails.
  **After:** Both supplied-SWF and mock flows place Radar, submit the authored save form, observe it in the save callback, export/import via the production codec and load it back into the editor. A fresh World locks and rejects the same design. Current GP affordability remains enforced.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 586 tests / 6,683 assertions, production build and all 10 affected browser cases pass without skips. Existing save/name/code/reload, creator loading and candidate eligibility flows pass. Native/mock retained/fresh captures inspected.
- Full profile-storage/cheat behavior and synchronized original-runtime/game parity remain unproven. No media or storage-format changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

Revert the readonly snapshot propagation and its fixture coverage together.

**Blast Radius:** Creator

In-game palette, save validation and viewer loading now use the existing run-owned unlock list.
